name: two-targets-split
description: Two monsters of one variety side by side, cast at one of them by reference: the shape every multi-target test needs (split, splash, chain, area, pierce). A label cannot name one of two identical monsters, so each spawn is referenced instead.

steps.note: a second one of the same variety would make '/cast ... Rhoa' ambiguous
resolves to the id the first spawn learned, so the Gateway cannot pick the wrong monster
the id says which monster was hit; the label cannot, because both share it
